title: University Pilot Sales Strategy
authorization: Documentation only; no sending or CRM-write authorization granted
source: repository default university sales runbook; current live version unverified

stages.evidence: University fit and credible need hypothesis, with a source and verification date.
stages.action: Research owner records contacts, missing evidence and next action.
stages.exit: Outreach Queued only when fit, two stakeholders and draft preparation are complete.

stages.evidence: Named owner, two verified stakeholders, relevant message and approved resource.
stages.action: Prepare Gmail sender, recipient, follow-up plan, call task and authorization record.
stages.exit: First Email Sent only after a verified send result; a draft stays queued.

stages.evidence: Verified Day 1 Gmail send, logged with recipient, time and message/thread reference.
stages.action: Read replies before the next touch. Record the completed action in the contact activity log, verify the saved log, then move the card and set the next action/date.
stages.exit: A substantive reply moves directly to Engaged or the appropriate outcome. Stop requests suppress outreach. Advance to another touchpoint only after that action is verified; log any skipped touch explicitly.

stages.evidence: Human-confirmed Day 4 call attempt, logged with time, caller and actual outcome.
stages.action: Read replies before the next touch. Record the completed action in the contact activity log, verify the saved log, then move the card and set the next action/date.
stages.exit: A substantive reply moves directly to Engaged or the appropriate outcome. Stop requests suppress outreach. Advance to another touchpoint only after that action is verified; log any skipped touch explicitly.

stages.evidence: Verified Day 8 Gmail follow-up in the existing thread, logged with send evidence.
stages.action: Read replies before the next touch. Record the completed action in the contact activity log, verify the saved log, then move the card and set the next action/date.
stages.exit: A substantive reply moves directly to Engaged or the appropriate outcome. Stop requests suppress outreach. Advance to another touchpoint only after that action is verified; log any skipped touch explicitly.

stages.evidence: Verified Day 12 final outreach email in Gmail, logged with send evidence.
stages.action: Read replies before the next touch. Record the completed action in the contact activity log, verify the saved log, then move the card and set the next action/date.
stages.exit: A substantive reply moves directly to Engaged or the appropriate outcome. Stop requests suppress outreach. Advance to another touchpoint only after that action is verified; log any skipped touch explicitly.

stages.evidence: Relevant human reply or conversation; record interest, objection or referral.
stages.action: Pause generic follow-ups. Qualify priority, workflow, timing and buying group.
stages.exit: Meeting Scheduled requires an agreed time and attendees; a proposed time is insufficient.

stages.action: Prepare discovery and persona-specific demonstration. Log findings and technical questions after the meeting.
stages.exit: Proposal Sent requires completed discovery/validation evidence, approved terms and confirmed proposal delivery.

stages.evidence: Approved scope, cohort, responsibilities, support path, price and dates sent to the buyer.
stages.action: Track questions, procurement/security path and the agreed review date.
stages.exit: Negotiating requires actual buyer discussion of terms or changes; silence is not negotiation.

stages.evidence: Documented buyer requests and unresolved commercial or procurement issues.
stages.action: Prepare responses; founder owns pricing, commitments and exceptions.
stages.exit: Pilot Agreed requires documented mutual agreement on scope, price and responsibilities.

stages.evidence: Mutual agreement and a defined contracting path.
stages.action: Coordinate contract review and launch preparation; record unresolved conditions.
stages.exit: Contract Signed requires the executed agreement, not verbal approval.

stages.evidence: Verified executed agreement with scope, value and term.
stages.action: Record pilot value separately from post-pilot annual value. Assign implementation owner.
stages.exit: Pilot Active requires completed launch tasks and first valid reporting week. A free pilot contract is not paid conversion.

stages.evidence: Launch complete, confirmed cohort and valid reporting inputs.
stages.action: Weekly scorecard; coach/coordinator working review every two weeks; midpoint buyer review.
stages.exit: Pilot Complete requires end-of-pilot review and recorded outcome. Track paid conversion, renewal and expansion separately.

stages.evidence: Documented results, limitations, buyer decision and follow-through owner.
stages.action: Hand off paid delivery, a bounded extension, expansion or agreed closure.
stages.exit: No automatic revenue claim. Link the commercial outcome and its actual signed value.

stages.evidence: Recorded reason and explicit distinction between lost and paused.
stages.action: For paused accounts, keep a restart condition and date. For stop requests, suppress outreach.
stages.exit: Reopen only with documented new evidence and appropriate authorization.

outreach.requirement: Verify institutional fit, source freshness and at least two relevant stakeholders. Draft one credible workflow hypothesis.
Observation, relevant problem, useful outcome and one 10–15 minute ask. Confirm recipient and sending authorization.
Assigned human makes the call; voicemail references the first email and stays under 25 seconds. Record the actual outcome.
Use the existing thread and one approved workflow visual, pilot blueprint or case study. Illustrative examples remain labeled.
Offer two real availability options, ask for the correct owner or request permission to reconnect.
Use an actual season, budget, event or new approved evidence trigger. Record the reason and next date; avoid indefinite automatic chasing.

responses.action: Pause generic sequence; record the stated need and route to founder for discovery. Offer only confirmed availability with authorization.
Record referral evidence, verify the new person and suppression status; prepare a relevant introduction.
responses.stageRule: Keep the account stage evidence-based; new contact is not automatically engaged.

responses.action: Record the requested timing and reason. Pause the sequence and schedule an authorized revisit.
responses.stageRule: Paused with restart condition and date.

responses.action: Record the objection accurately. Prepare a response grounded in approved product facts and the current workflow.
responses.stageRule: Founder handles pricing, clinical, compliance and contractual questions.

responses.action: Continue only the approved remaining touches. After the sequence, move to trigger-based nurture.
responses.stageRule: Do not advance based on delivery, opens or clicks.

responses.action: Stop further outreach immediately through the authorized suppression workflow; verify sequence is paused and alert the owner.
responses.stageRule: Record do-not-contact status. If access fails, escalate urgently; do not send.

responses.action: Stop the sequence; verify the address and delivery state before any retry.
responses.stageRule: Report blocked delivery; never invent a replacement address.

responses.action: Re-read the record and provider state. Reconcile whether the action completed before retrying.
responses.stageRule: Unknown outcome stays unresolved; prevent duplicate sends or updates.

fields.rule: Check for existing organization/contact records before adding a lead.

fields.fields: Owner, Priority, Next Step, Next Action Required Date
fields.rule: One concrete action with a person and date. Do not infer an owner from a name mentioned in notes.

fields.fields: Contact Emails, Contact Phone, LinkedIn URL, Decision Maker
fields.rule: Verify role and source. Record champion and other stakeholders in structured notes when no dedicated field exists.
Record date, actor, observed result, source and next step. Separate facts, hypotheses and proposed actions.

fields.fields: Amount, ACV, Expected Close Date, Contract Term
fields.rule: Label pilot value and post-pilot annual value separately. Stage probability is not observed conversion evidence.

fields.fields: Pilot Scope, Athlete Count, Pilot Start, Pilot End, Expansion Path
fields.rule: Add success plan, review dates, support contacts and handoff owner.

fields.fields: Loss Reason, notes and linked commercial evidence
fields.rule: Differentiate paid conversion, renewal, expansion, extension, paused and closed lost.

emailChannel.sender: founder-approved business Gmail inbox; verify exact account before sending
emailChannel.crm: PipeLists for stages, activity logs, owners and next actions
prohibited: Fallback to Brevo when Gmail is unavailable
beforeSend: Verify sender, recipient, latest Gmail thread, replies, suppression, scheduled touches and prior sends
Block while an existing Brevo sequence is active; an authorized owner must pause and verify its stop
Verify authorized Gmail send/read access; otherwise draft only
emailChannel.stopRules: Pause generic follow-ups on reply; stop on opt-out or delivery failure; verify queued sends cancelled
emailChannel.tracking: Log Gmail evidence in PipeLists; automatic sync unverified; Brevo events are not Gmail evidence
emailChannel.unknownOutcome: Reconcile Gmail Sent and thread before retrying; never switch provider

touchpoints.rule: Latest verified completed touchpoint; full history stays in activity logs. Dates alone never advance a card.
touchpoints.legacy: cold-email-sent retains its ID and becomes First Email Sent; do not infer later touches from legacy cards.
touchpoints.afterFinal: Keep Final Outreach Email Sent until a reply, explicit pause/closure or approved nurture action; no automatic Engaged transition.

commercialBaseline.existingAgreementRule: Existing executed agreements, including UMES’s existing pilot, remain unchanged.
commercialBaseline.customScopeRule: Document different cohort, implementation, integration and recurring requirements in a written scope of work.
commercialBaseline.discountRule: Multi-year discounts are quoted in the written proposal. Verify internal approval before quoting discounts, changing the minimum or stacking credits. Private policy is maintained outside public assets.

inboundIntake.cadence: Review the receiving inbox each business day

websiteForm.inbox: Visible in the connected Gmail inbox

inboundIntake.crmIngestion: Manual University Pilots intake; no automatic CRM ingestion
steps: Deduplicate organization and contact before creating or updating an opportunity through the authorized PipeLists workflow.
Record source page, available email message/thread reference, stated need, owner, next action and due date.
Assign a stage only after human validation of the inquiry and its evidence.
Keep pilot value separate from potential annual value.
inboundIntake.testRule: Exclude clearly labeled tests from forecasts and outreach.
inboundIntake.verificationRule: Verify inbox delivery and saved CRM record separately; endpoint success alone does not establish either.
inboundIntake.channelBoundary: Gmail-only governs buyer outreach. Internal transactional website notifications do not authorize Brevo sales campaigns.
